# Third-party dependencies

External sources and binary distributions stay here so they are never confused
with code maintained by this project.

```bash
git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/spcl/QuaRot.git tools/third_party/QuaRot
git -C tools/third_party/QuaRot checkout 5008669b08c1f11f9b64d52d16fddd47ca754c5a
```

Compatible prebuilt EasyFHE wheels may be placed in `tools/third_party/wheels/`.

See [docs/REPRODUCING.md](../../docs/REPRODUCING.md).
